label: Named author at New Zealand Geospatial Research Conference 2022
basis: New Zealand Geospatial Research Conference 2022 programme, Massey Geoinformatics Collaboratory lists Ian Diaz-Rainey as an author of “Modelling climate-related coastal flooding hazards and residential property values”. The author-name variant is reconciled to Ivan Diaz-Rainey using the University of Otago STRAND project record.
